_comment: The intended configuration of the Fabric deployment pipeline, recorded as text so it can be
reviewed and so a new item cannot be promoted without someone deciding what happens to its
connections. Deployment rules themselves are set in the portal: this file is the specification
and the checklist, not an importable artefact.
The rule that repoints the default lakehouse is the most important line here. Promote without it
and production reads development data, which is the worst kind of bug: everything works and the

stages.name: Development
stages.note: The only workspace connected to Git. Everything starts here.

stages.name: Production
stages.note: Fed only by promotion from Development, so there is exactly one path into production.

rules.why: Without this rule the promoted notebook keeps writing to the development lakehouse.
Also needs Files/legacy/Monthly_Portfolio_Pack.xlsx present in the production lakehouse.
Monitoring must watch production's own run log, not development's.

rules.development: SQL analytics endpoint of lh_portfolio in portfolio-reporting-dev
rules.production: SQL analytics endpoint of lh_portfolio in portfolio-reporting-prod
rules.why: A Direct Lake model promoted without this rule would read development gold tables.
Fabric rebinds activities to the promoted items. Check each activity after the first promotion.

not_promoted.why: The wheel is built in CI and published per workspace, so each stage gets its own Environment and the version in use is explicit.
not_promoted.action: Upload the same wheel version to the production Environment before promoting the notebooks.

not_promoted.why: Data is not promoted. Production lands its own files and builds its own tables.
not_promoted.action: Create the lakehouse in production once, with the same name, and land files into Files/landing.

before_promoting: The development pipeline run is green, including the monitoring activity.
dq_results has no failed ERROR check in the latest batch.
The wheel version in the production Environment matches the one in development.
The semantic model opens in development and row level security has been tested as each role.
after_promoting: Run the production pipeline once by hand and check ops_pipeline_run has a SUCCEEDED row per step.
Check ops_freshness in production shows no stale source.
Open the production report and confirm the migration evidence page shows 0 unexplained differences.
